response: Christopher Nolan’s *Oppenheimer*, a gripping 2023 drama and historical epic, delves into the life of the "father of the atomic bomb" with a runtime of 180 minutes. Produced on a $100 million budget, the critically acclaimed film became a massive success, grossing $952 million worldwide and earning an impressive 8.3 on IMDb and a 93% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Its impact was further cemented when it won the Oscar for Best Picture, solidifying its place as a standout cinematic achievement.
